ai_summary: Alankit Limited has announced the appointment of Finportal Investments Private Limited as its Investor Relations (IR) Agency and established a dedicated email for investor correspondence, effective September 2, 2026. This move, made in compliance with SEBI regulations, is a positive step expected to enhance investor communication, transparency, and responsiveness. No red flags are identified; it signifies a proactive approach to corporate governance and stakeholder engagement.
